name: Agent voice
author: Brett
description: Agents speak: a per-agent voice and narrator console (device voices on the phone or browser, cloud voices from OpenAI or ElevenLabs with keys kept on the server; speed, pitch, volume, presets, read modes, code / link / number / emoji rules, pauses, emphasis, intro and outro, chime, pronunciations, permissions, try-it preview, import/export). A live status light on the banner and in the Assistant title bar while the selected agent is a voice agent (ready, speaking, listening, paused). A microphone in the Assistant window that says which agent is missing which permission (one-tap fix), with tap / hold / toggle modes, live text, send and cancel phrases, spoken punctuation, barge-in and conversation mode, sharing the microphone with AmberX hands-free listening, dictation and Speak a command through the page's mic lease (mic-lease@1) so they never conflict. Hooks to its settings in the app menu (Plugins, View), right-click, the banner light, the Assistant title bar and search.
